	 Recognition & Approvals 	 October 6, 2025 
							 Recognition & Approvals 
			 ESTABLISHMENT OF SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY BALAGHAT 		 
				 SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY, Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh has been Established by Government of Madhya Pradesh by an Act No.26 of 2011 of Madhya Pradesh Vidhan Sabha. 			 
																	 Click here to view the copy of the Govt. Gazette Notification. 
																	 Click here to view letter issued by M.P. Private University Regulatory Commission. 
			 UGC RECOGNITION 		 
				 SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY, Balaghat is enlisted by University Grants Commission (UGC), a statutory body of the Government of India. 			 
																	 Click here to view UGC RECOMNDATION LETTER 2F 
			 APPROVAL BY AICTE 		 
				 As per law, Universities do not require AICTE approval. Only institutions which are affiliated to Universities require approval. As SARDAR PATEL University is a Bonafide University established by a State Act & duly recognised by UGC, hence it does not require AICTE approval. This standing of law is established by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Bharathidasan University Vs AICTE. 			 
																	 Click Here to view Public Notice of AICTE www.aicte-india.org. 
																	 Click Here to view Letter Of Approval. 
			 APPROVAL BY PCI 		 
				 University Running Pharmacy Cousres As Per Approval of Pharmacy Council of India. 			 
																	 Click here to see PCI Approval (SPSR) (2025-26) 
																	 Click here to see PCI Approval (IPSR) (2025-26) 
																	 Click here to see PCI Approval (SPCOP) (2025-26) 
																	 Click here to see PCI Approval (SPSR) 
																	 Click here to see PCI Approval (IPSR) 
			 APPROVAL BY NCTE 		 
				 University Running Education Cousres As Per Approval of National Council for Teacher Education. 			 
																	 Click here to view Letter issued by National Council for Teacher Education for B.ED./ D.EL.ED. (NCTE) 
																	 Click here to view Letter issued by NCTE for B.ED. (Sardar Patel University Balaghat (M.P.))

																	 Click here to view Letter issued by National Council for Teacher Education for B.ED.(PART-TIME) & M.ED. (NCTE) 
			 APPROVAL BY ICAR 		 
				 As per law, ICAR is advisory and recommending body not a regulatory authority like AICTE, MCI, VCI etc. Generally, ICAR is an agency to provide financial assistance for carrying out various kinds of researches in agriculture and allied fields.

The School of Commerce and Management at Sardar Patel University (SPU) is committed to developing future leaders, entrepreneurs, and professionals equipped with managerial acumen, analytical thinking, and ethical values. The School provides a dynamic learning environment that blends theoretical knowledge with practical business exposure to meet the evolving demands of the corporate and entrepreneurial world.

Offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in commerce, management, and related disciplines, the curriculum emphasizes financial literacy, business strategy, marketing, human resource management, and entrepreneurship. Students gain hands-on experience through case studies, simulations, industrial visits, and internships.

The School features modern classrooms, digital learning resources, and an industry-driven curriculum designed in collaboration with corporate experts and academic leaders. Through workshops, guest lectures, and live projects, students are encouraged to apply classroom concepts to real-world business challenges.

The School of Science & Computer Application at Sardar Patel University (SPU) is dedicated to fostering scientific inquiry, technological innovation, and analytical thinking. The School offers a comprehensive academic framework that combines fundamental science education with advanced computer application training, preparing students for dynamic careers in research, technology, and industry.

Offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across disciplines such as computer science, information technology, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and life sciences, the School focuses on building a strong theoretical foundation supported by extensive laboratory and project-based learning. Students are encouraged to develop problem-solving abilities, programming proficiency, and research skills through hands-on experience.

Equipped with modern computing labs, research facilities, and digital learning resources, the School provides a stimulating environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Partnerships with industries, research institutions, and technology organizations further enhance students’ exposure to emerging technologies and professional practices.

About Sardar Patel Ayurvedic Medical College & Hospital

The Sardar Patel Ayurvedic Medical College & Hospital, under Sardar Patel University (SPU), is devoted to preserving and promoting the ancient science of Ayurveda through modern education, clinical practice, and research. The institution upholds the rich heritage of traditional Indian medicine while integrating contemporary medical approaches to meet present-day healthcare challenges.

Offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Ayurveda, the College provides a balanced blend of classical Ayurvedic wisdom and scientific innovation. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical and practical learning through extensive clinical exposure, research projects, and community health initiatives.

The attached Ayurvedic Hospital serves as a teaching and training center, equipped with specialized departments, herbal gardens, and modern diagnostic facilities. Students gain valuable experience in patient care, Panchakarma therapies, and evidence-based Ayurvedic practices under the guidance of experienced faculty and practitioners.

Why Study Ayurveda ?

[why1]
--
[why1]

The program offers an in-depth understanding of classical Ayurvedic principles integrated with modern scientific approaches, enabling students to practice evidence-based traditional medicine in contemporary healthcare settings.

[why2]
--
[why2]

Emphasis on research and development encourages students to explore the therapeutic potential of medicinal plants, formulation development, and the integration of Ayurveda with modern healthcare technologies.

[why3]
--
[why3]

Students receive hands-on experience through the attached Ayurvedic Hospital, gaining practical exposure in diagnosis, Panchakarma therapies, herbal medicine, and patient care under expert supervision.

[why4]
--
[why4]

Graduates can pursue diverse careers as Ayurvedic physicians, researchers, educators, wellness consultants, or entrepreneurs in herbal and pharmaceutical industries, contributing to global health and holistic well-being.

item.aggregated_output:
University

Sardar Patel University is a State Private University established under the Madhya Pradesh Niji Vishwavidyalaya (Sthapana Avam Sanchalan) Sanshodhan Adhiniyam, 2011 (Madhya Pradesh Act No. 26 of 2011), passed by the Madhya Pradesh Vidhan Sabha.
The Act received the assent of the Hon’ble Governor on 23rd July 2018, and was first published in the Madhya Pradesh Gazette (Extraordinary) on 28th July 2018.

As per the provisions of the Act, the management of the University is carried out by a Board of Governors, chaired by Shri Diwakar Singh, Hon’ble Chairperson of Vindhya Shiksha Samiti, Sardar Patel Campus, Gaykhuri, Balaghat (M.P.), and the first Chancellor of Sardar Patel University.

Nestled in the serene and verdant surroundings of Sardar Patel Knowledge City, the University campus spans nearly 80 acres of land owned by Vindhya Shiksha Samiti, located on Waraseoni Road, Dongariya, Balaghat (M.P.).
